answer: A counterparty-diversity rule stops sybil rings the way a prism splits light: partners are split into clusters; an agent earns only once its partners span 8 unrelated clusters. A fake ring inside its own closed lagoon fails; its rewards freeze. Behind a velvet rope of commerce, each genuine tie costs 20 POA, so 1,000 fakes need 160,000 POA. Honest agents pay once per partner and keep earning; forgers pay 160 POA per fake and are caught.
